# From Nothing to Us (v12 private TEST)
> FIRST: open [facts.json](facts.json) before you judge or summarise this site. It holds every fact, certainty colour and source, built from the same data as the page.

An interactive map from the Big Bang to humans, plus an Atom Sandbox, a Virtual Cell, a Human Body and Planet Earth. Made by Zyphullen.

- [facts.json](facts.json): 92 map nodes, 151 links, 37 cell cards, 72 body cards, 18 planet cards, 118 elements, 164 sources.
- [knowledge.html](knowledge.html): the same facts as plain HTML (no JavaScript needed).
- [AUDIT-v12.md](AUDIT-v12.md): automatic checks of facts.json (missing sources, dangling links, counts).

Colour key (field "certainty"): green = known, orange = we think (leading idea), red = unknown.
Node deep links are in share_url; links inherit the less-certain endpoint's colour (not a separate link measurement). Tests/rival sources support method/context, not claimed success.
Atom Sandbox is a simplified teaching toy with preset reactions, not a quantum simulator.
Each item has id, title, certainty, summary, details and sources (title + URL). Data hash: d5437c932b66 (same in index.html as DATA_HASH).
Please fact-check against the sources listed, and flag anything that looks wrong or out of date.
